headline: Casualties Surge on Multiple Fronts as Enlistments Rise
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the fighting has intensified across the most contested sectors. On Nevish Line the latest hour records roughly twenty‑five Colonial and one Warden dead with forty‑four new enlistees, a sharp rise from the earlier ten‑and‑six toll. Callums Cape now sees about twelve hundred Colonial and sixteen hundred Warden casualties per hour alongside one‑hundred‑eighty‑two enlistments, roughly doubling the previous surge. Linn Mercy adds ninety‑two Colonial and three‑hundred‑thirteen Warden losses per hour with thirty‑six recruits, up from sixty‑four and two‑eleven. Weathered Expanse reports one‑hundred‑nineteen Colonial and one‑hundred‑thirty‑five Warden dead per hour and eighteen enlistments, a fourfold increase. Mooring County remains the bloodiest theatre, posting roughly thirteen hundred Colonial and fifteen hundred Warden casualties per hour with one‑hundred‑forty‑five new troops. Marban Hollow shows a modest two Colonial and thirteen Warden losses per hour but nineteen enlistments, all trends marked accelerating. Event logs confirm heightened base turnover on these fronts, with Nevish Line, Callums Cape, Linn Mercy, Weathered Expanse, Mooring County and Marban Hollow together accounting for the bulk of ownership changes in the past day.
